trigger: Publication audit identified that raw p-values for four registered secondary threshold and follow-up checks could be read as unadjusted confirmatory evidence.

secondary_family: 5 percent loss threshold at one year
20 percent loss threshold at one year
10 percent loss threshold at two years
10 percent loss threshold at three years
reporting_change.correction: Holm step-down correction across the four secondary checks
reporting_change.rationale: This is more conservative than leaving the related secondary checks unadjusted and does not promote them to primary tests.

selection_diagnostic.interpretation: The threshold analysis assesses whether the direction depends on the 70 percent support boundary. It cannot recover excluded low-forest cells, prove missing-at-random selection, or remove transportability limits.
